notes.title: Alpha 1.8
notes.content:
[u][b]New Features:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] [b]New Map: [/b]Campsite.
[*] [b]New Enemies:[/b] Ghost Trolls.
[*] [b]New weapons: [/b]Ghostly Executioner(Axe), Battler(Great Axe)
[*] Added Triple Threat mode, a mix of all current challenge modes.
[/list]

[b][u]Changes:[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] All classes have been reset, and primary/secondary weapons now have separate categories.
[*] You can now reset all or separate classes at will
[*] Setting Menu Rework.
[*] Level Class select menu rework.
[*] New theme music.
[*] Changed Standard Crosshairs
[*] Lucky strike & Shielded unlock level swapped. Lucky strike now being available from level 7, and shielded from level 13.
[*] Changed melee range from box area based, to point ray cast based. Meaning for better range, and more accurate hits.
[*] Font change.
[*] Modes are now unlocked with levels.
[*] Slightly reduced time before the player begins healing.
[*] Lowered required amount of kills needed for angel statues on the barracks from 15, to 8.
[*] Halved damage dealt by all enemies.
[*] Blue slimes and Assassin trolls now give more points on death.
[*] Small map changes on The Barracks.
[*] New Application Icon.
[/list]

[b][u]Fixes:[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you could select classes without being the appropriate level.
[*] Fixed a bug where audio preferences wasn't being applied.
[*] Fixed a bug stopping settings being saved.
[*] Fixed Render issues on intro.
[*] Fixed an issue where the club class button would unlock before the skull basher.
[*] Removed a chair on the barracks, that was causing slimes to get stuck on spawn.
[*] Fixed issue with projectiles being stuck/hitting invisible barriers (apply to barracks).
[*] Fixed a bug where Assassin trolls were dealing double damage.
[*] Fixed some missing collisions on The Barracks.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Alpha (1.7)
notes.content:
[b]Christmas Event is now here! Decorations are hidden around the maps, can you find them all?[/b]

[b][u]Additions:[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] Added footsteps to the player.
[*] Added power Easter egg objectives for The Barracks.
[*] Added power weapon to The Barracks, complete the Easter egg to obtain for that game.
[*] Added a audio cue to find the blacksmith
[*] Added footsteps to troll enemies.

[*] Added Power Ups and De-buffs that you can get from enemies.

[list]
[b](Power Ups):[/b]
[*] Freebee = Next purchase is free.
[*] Double Points = Doubles points earned for 15 seconds
[*] point boost = Rewards the player 1000 points
[*] speed = Boosts player speed for 15 seconds

[b] (De-buffs):[/b]
[*] Deduction = Removes 1000 points from the player.
[*] Taxation = Next purchase is doubled.
[/list]
[/list]


[u][b]Changes:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Changed some door costs.
[*] Changed blacksmith spawn location in lab on The Barracks.
[*] Changed look of staff projectiles.
[*] Chests are now interactable.
[*] Increased accuracy of ranged weapons.
[*] Reduced mixed variant round start cap from 25, to 10.
[*] Moved an enemy spawn in landing east, on Last stand.
[*] Upgraded metal textures.
[*] Upgraded Weapon textures.
[/list]

[u][b]Fixes:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Fixed Vegetation not having snow on The Barracks.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could only use the blacksmith, if you had over the amount required.
[*] Fixed an issue where some doors would not open others intended.
[*] Fixed an issue where a door could trap players against a table on the barracks.
[*] Fixed an issue where looking through certain barrels and boxes, create a clipping issue.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could get stuck on doorframes on The Barracks.
[*] Fixed an issue where fog changes were delayed by a round.
[*] Fixed enemies teleporting back to their original position, making the flow of rounds slow.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed enemies to walk through the blacksmith area.
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha 1.6
notes.content:
[u][b]Double XP event is now over, but fear not, the Christmas event is around the corner[/b][/u]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where wave stings would not sound on Last Stand.
[*] Fixed an issue where fog wasn't being updated when required.
[*] Fixed issue where wave stings would not be affected by music volume.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fog changes and wave stings now happen at the start of waves, rather then at the end of them.
[*] The Blacksmith now has a delayed initial spawn of 10 seconds.
[*] The Blacksmith now takes 7 seconds before appearing in a new location.
[*] Reduced time between waves from 15 seconds, to 10 seconds.
[*] Graphics upgrade.
[*] Objects in courtyard on The Barracks, are now covered in a layer of snow.
[*] Water visuals have been upgraded.
[*] Changed spawn point on Last Stand
[/list].

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added post processing.
[*]Added description pop ups for weapons, perks and Maps.
[*] Added 3 challenge modes:
[list]
[*] One Hit,
[*] Starting Room,
[*] Mystery Weapon.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha 1.5.2
notes.content:
[u][b]Second Part to the hotfix[/b][/u]

[b]Bug Fixes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the staff category in armory, was accessible before the first staff weapon is unlocked.
[*] Fixed issue where the blacksmiths beacon had a collider, and casted shadows.

[list]
[*] Added hit particles to enemies
[*] Added more animations to Slimes.
[*] Added new death animation for the Assassin.
[*] Added a temporary universal sound effect to melee weapons.
[*] Added ladder door in Entrance, on Last Stand.

notes.title: Update Alpha 1.5.1.2
notes.content: A few extra changes and adjustments to ensure bug fixes are correctly implemented.

notes.title: Alpha 1.5.1 (Hotfix)
notes.content:
[u][b]Additions:[/b][/u]

Added The Blacksmith:
Too many points with nothing left to buy? The Blacksmith might be just what you need!
For 1,000 points, get a new, random weapon from the blacksmith. But, the blacksmith will move around the map the more you buy from him, 
meaning you could find yourself in a challenging room to survive in.

Added a temporary universal animation for attacking using melee weapons.


[u][b]Fixes:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where players were unable to quit the game, due to a miscommunication with steam stats.
[*] Fixed issue where Slimes were not attacking.
[*] Fixed audio slider issues and unassigned audio.

[*] Fixed an issue where a large rock, clipped through and blocked part of Accommodation on The Barracks.
[*] Fixed issue where the slimes inside examination tanks are affected by the spotter perk.
[/list]

notes.title: Extending our sincerest apologies
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 
First of all, I'd like to apologize for the state of the game from launch.

This was not my intention, both the amount of bugs, and overpricing for the amount of content provided.

To rectify this, [b]the following changes and additions will be made[/b]:

[u][b]Price Reduction:[/b][/u] To begin with, we have reduced the game to [b][u]$1.99 /£1.69[/u][/b], with this, the [b]15% off[/b] for launch will still be active.

[u][b]Hotfix:[/b][/u] We will be updating the game with a [b]two part hotfix[/b], 
the first part will tackle the main issues such as: 

[list]
[*] Enemies unable to deal damage to the player,
[*] Unable to quit the game,
[*] Enemies spawning on rooftops and appearing to fall from the sky,
[*] and a few other issues.
[/list]

The second part of the Hotfix, will focus on:

[list]
[*] Animations for Melee weapons,
[*] Sounds for weapons and impacts,
[*] and more.
[/list]

Along with the first Hotfix, we will be introducing a [b]new game mechanic[/b]:

[b]The Blacksmith: [/b]Too many points with nothing left to buy? The Blacksmith might be just what you need!
For 1,000 points, get a new, random weapon from the blacksmith. But, the blacksmith will move around the map the more you buy from him, meaning you could find yourself in a challenging room to survive in.

As another way to apologize, we will be hosting [b]Double XP[/b] for the entire week, starting with the first part of the hotfix!

Again, I would like to extend my sincerest apologies, and would also like to thank those who left reviews, and alerted me to the issues.
With your help, I can work towards making this game better!

[b]Many Apologies and thanks,[/b]

[b]Jamie @IceCharge Productions[/b]
